description:
A research librarian is preparing a bibliography that requires full, unabbreviated journal titles. Your task is to locate 4 specific classic papers in the Zotero library and update their 'Publication' field from the current abbreviation to the official full title.

Target Papers and required changes:
1. Einstein (1905) 'On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies': Change 'Ann. Phys.' to 'Annalen der Physik'
2. McCarthy (1960) 'Recursive Functions...': Change 'Comm. ACM' to 'Communications of the ACM'
3. Dijkstra (1959) 'A Note on Two Problems...': Change 'Numer. Math.' to 'Numerische Mathematik'
4. Shannon (1948) 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication': Change 'Bell Syst. Tech. J.' to 'Bell System Technical Journal'

Steps:
1. Search for each paper.
2. Click the 'Info' tab in the right panel.
3. Edit the 'Publication' field to match the full title exactly.
4. Ensure the change is saved (click away or press Enter).

einstein.title: On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies

dijkstra.title: A Note on Two Problems in Connexion with Graphs
